name: Wanman Startup Studio
idea: A stage-gated multi-agent operating system that helps AI-native founders validate startup ideas, decide when to build, and prepare a tightly scoped MVP without confusing prototype creation for customer validation.
founderContext: Solo technical founder building internal tools and AI workflows for early-stage teams.
targetCustomers: micro startup teams before seed funding
product builders validating new AI products
region: global, English-first outputs with Chinese operator notes
hypotheses: AI-native founders can build too quickly and need a gate that forces validation before MVP work.
A local file-based agent workflow is more trustworthy than a black-box startup generator.
The first paid use case is repeatable idea validation plus MVP scope control.
mustAnswer: Is the problem frequent and painful enough for a founder workflow product?
Which customer segment should be interviewed first?
What evidence would block or pivot the idea?
What is the smallest MVP scope if the Idea Gate passes?

constraints.sourcePolicy: Use local evidence or reputable URLs for factual claims. Mark unsupported details as needs verification.
constraints.stageGatePolicy: Do not build MVP assets before Idea Gate approval.
